map.在线语音转文字工具，浏览器本地用 Web Speech API 将录音实时识别为: Online speech-to-text tool: the browser uses the Web Speech API locally to transcribe recordings into Chinese text in real time, supports proofreading and copying, does not upload data, and is pure front end.
map.在浏览器本地用 Web Speech API 将麦克风录音实时识别为中文文本。: Uses the Web Speech API locally in the browser to transcribe microphone audio into Chinese text in real time.
map.纯前端、不上传音频，保护隐私；适合会议纪要、字幕与速记。: Pure front end with no audio uploaded, which protects privacy; good for meeting minutes, subtitles, and shorthand notes.
map.识别受口音、噪声与网络语音引擎可用性影响，长段需分段校对。: Recognition is affected by accent, noise, and the availability of the network speech engine; long passages need segment-by-segment proofreading.
map.：点击录音后口述'明天上午十点开会'，工具实时返回'明天上午十点开会'。环境嘈杂: : Click record and say "meeting at ten tomorrow morning" and the tool returns "meeting at ten tomorrow morning" in real time. In a noisy environment or with proper nouns it may misrecognize, so check key details by hand.
map.为什么有时识别不了？: Why Does It Sometimes Fail to Recognize?
map.Web Speech API 在部分浏览器/环境需联网调用系统语音引擎，离线或无: In some browsers or environments the Web Speech API needs network access to call the system speech engine and will fail offline or without permission; heavy accents and loud noise also reduce accuracy.
map.本工具在浏览器内处理、不上传；但是否真正本地取决于浏览器实现，部分引擎仍会调用云: This tool processes in the browser without uploads; whether it is truly local depends on the browser implementation, and some engines still call cloud recognition services, so confirm before using sensitive content.
